source: SRI24 atlas, spgr T1 template — healthy adult average, not a patient
citation: Rohlfing T, Zahr NM, Sullivan EV, Pfefferbaum A. The SRI24 multichannel atlas of normal adult human brain structure. Hum Brain Mapp. 2010;31(5):798-819.
coord_note: X = voxel axis0 (R->L), Y = voxel axis2 (I->S, up), Z = -voxel axis1 (A->P); matches twin-meta.json (d->X, w->Y, h->Z). Centred on bbox centre and scaled uniformly so the largest half-extent equals the twin brain's.
